result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is clipped — the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word, indicating the card is partially outside the viewport without a clear affordance that it's horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator (e.g., a partial card peek or scroll arrow) to communicate horizontal scrollability, or ensure the truncated text uses an ellipsis and the card layout is intentionally designed as a carousel.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen with no visual cue that content continues below, which may confuse users into thinking the page ends there.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible card is clearly cropped enough to signal scrollability, or add a subtle shadow/gradient at the bottom to indicate more content is available below.
